observation: v0.8 closed inclusion index-binding ambiguity, but Adapter v0.3 still routed inclusion through v0.6 and backend labels did not prove exact backend source identity.
prior_belief: Versioned backend names plus policy digests were sufficient local substitution controls.
intervention: Built v0.4 to pin v0.8 strict inclusion, separate inclusion/transition identities, bind manifest leaf hash, and verify build-time dependency source SHA-256 at runtime.
measured_outcome: 28/28 focused tests; 105/105 regression; 3,226/3,226 adapter attacks; 4/4 real backend-file tamper checks; v0.7/v0.8 property matrices remain green before final packaging.
confidence_delta: increased for local downgrade/integrity resistance; unchanged for real ecosystem transfer
failure_or_surprise: No new implementation bug after dependency-pin addition; real sibling manifest still absent.
reusable_lesson: Pin both semantic version identity and exact verifier bytes; a label alone is not an artifact identity.
invalidated_assumption: Backend version names alone adequately detect verifier substitution.
retry_condition: Re-run when a real signed sibling manifest or changed backend source becomes available.
next_experiment: Real sibling Transfer first; otherwise a non-authoritative conformance kit to make the required manifest contract explicit.
